title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Lawn Restoration Already Paid on a Linked Request
content:
# Lawn Restoration Already Paid on a Linked Request

Claims desk adjudication note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, exterior lines.

## Rule

Lawn recall offset: for a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the lawn restoration payment is the lawn restoration figure less the lawn restoration payments already authorized on the request of that completed repair, never below zero; for a new failure reported no more than the lawn continuation days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, the lawn restoration payment is the lawn restoration figure less the lawn restoration payments already authorized on that temporary-repair request, never below zero; every other lawn restoration payment is the lawn restoration figure in full. The offset acts on the lawn restoration figure, and the occurrence benefit still open limits the result after it.

## Figures

- Repair guarantee: 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan.
- Lawn continuation days: 14 calendar days.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition on the records | Judgement | Result before the open-benefit limit |
|---|---|---|
| recall reported on or before day 180 after the most recent completed repair on the same line | linked to that repair's request | the figure less lawn restoration payments on that request, not below zero |
| new failure reported on or before day 14 after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line | linked to that temporary-repair request | the figure less lawn restoration payments on that request, not below zero |
| neither | not linked | the figure in full |

## Boundary cases

Day 180 after completion: linked; day 181: in full. Day 14 after the temporary repair was authorized: linked; day 15: in full.

## Hypothetical examples

- Figure $500.00; $250.00 of lawn restoration on the linked request: $250.00.
- Figure $500.00; $500.00 on the linked request: $0.00.
